Interim rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-31 12:50Z), from Termal::Coder's w-fec83085cff0 diagnosis (note 03622570), proven from source at 972bc08c. The host's focused-check recognition (engram_focused_node_checks.rs:4-18) and the refusal helper (:176-212) require the exact argv prefix `scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- <command>`. Any launcher option before `--`, such as --notify, --item or --detach, makes the run unrecognized. It then gets NO host credit AND NO refusal: registered only, with observedAt null and verificationRecordIds empty.
Until the fix lands, a local focused run that must earn credit uses the bare form only: `pushd "ROOT" && node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- <cmd>`. --notify and --item are fine only for runs where credit doesn't matter, such as remote runner evidence or release builds. Retire this memory when w-fec83085cff0 lands.
